# 🇧🇩 HI Cyber Con CTF

by HiddenInvestigations 🇧🇩 Bangladesh website CTFtime flag format `hiCTF{...}`

HI Cyber Con 2026 CTF is an international 48-hour Jeopardy-style Capture The Flag competition organized by Hidden Investigations.

The competition features 70+ challenges covering web, forensics, steganography, network, crypto, binary exploitation, reverse engineering, AI/LLM, hardware, blockchain, OSINT, and misc.

The CTF is fully online and open to teams of up to 5 participants worldwide.

Competition Divisions: HI Cyber Con 2026 features two divisions: Human-Led (AI permitted for reference only) and Agentic AI (AI-assisted and autonomous challenge solving permitted). Both divisions are eligible for the same overall USD 2,500 cash prize pool. Participation is free, with teams of 1–5 members.

Thank you for reaching out and for participating in Operation Cymbal: Cold Room!  Here are quick answers to your questions

  1. There are no scheduled daily releases of new challenges, so the full set available now represents the complete challenge set for this event. 

  2. The scoring system is dynamic as more users solve. The leaderboard was removed due to early flag captures prior to the event start, ensuring fairness for participants who followed the instructions.
